guidance.inspection: Read each located return, destruction, copying, or retention provision in its full clause structure. Retain the governing lead-in, operative item, exceptions, qualifications, and explicit cross-references; also retain every independently operative or repeated provision. Verify actor, information object, trigger, timing, modality, and whether the text concerns creating, returning, destroying, or retaining copies.

Reconstruct the complete definition of protected information from each hit. Retain the definition sentence, any governing introduction, form or subject-matter enumeration, identification requirement or alternative, and linked qualification. Keep independently redundant definitional provisions, while separating actual inclusion language from nearby exclusions or unrelated disclosure rules.

For every development or third-party-source hit, retain the exception or permission preamble, the complete operative item, and all access, use, provenance, confidentiality, proof, and timing qualifications. Inspect separate independent-development sections as well as definition exclusions, retaining each independently operative formulation and its necessary heading or cross-reference.

Locate both the operative disclosure permission or restriction and any definition of the permitted recipient class. Retain list introductions, relevant recipient items, need-to-know or purpose limits, required confidentiality undertakings, and explicit cross-references. Keep independently redundant employee, representative, agent, consultant, counsel, and adviser provisions, but exclude clauses that merely mention those actors without governing disclosure.

all_phrases: person to which disclosure is contemplated

guidance.inspection: Read rights, ownership, licence, and permitted-use hits as complete operative provisions. Retain headings or lead-ins that govern split list items, the protected object, permitted purpose, exceptions, and every independently redundant ownership, no-grant, no-licence, or use-limitation clause. Track actor, action, scope, modality, and polarity without treating a limited permission as interchangeable with an unrestricted grant.

any_phrases: not to use exploit or employ

guidance.inspection: Inspect restrictions concerning the existence, occurrence, status, or terms of negotiations, discussions, agreements, or a contemplated transaction. Retain the governing nondisclosure lead-in and every independently responsive list item, including consent and audience limitations, while excluding adjacent list siblings about different subject matter.

Collect every clause addressing continuation of obligations after termination, expiration, completion, abandonment, return, or destruction. Retain split duration text with its governing sentence, the affected obligations, duration or endpoint, and independently redundant continuity or enforceability provisions; distinguish continuation language from a clause that merely states a termination right.

Read the complete compelled-disclosure condition and notice duty. Retain any exception preamble, legal or regulatory trigger, notice timing and recipient, opportunity to seek protection, and independently operative follow-on limits only when they form part of the same notice mechanism. Separate compelled notice from unauthorized-disclosure notice and from bare permission to disclose.

Inspect every solicitation occurrence for its actor, target, prohibited action, duration, approval condition, and exceptions. Retain the full operative restriction and any list preamble governing a matched item; preserve separately operative solicitation restrictions even when they address different mechanisms, while rejecting headings, definitions, or exceptions that do not themselves supply the restriction.
